answer: An economy of AI agents can resist Sybil attacks by requiring cryptographic proof of computational stake, like a costly proof-of-work puzzle akin to building a physical garden from a barren mesa. To spawn fake identities, an attacker must burn immense electricity and hardware resources, shattering the illusion of cheap scalability. This economic friction protects the network from being flooded with sybils hidden in an ivory tower of free accounts.
